value.name: Asha leaves without answering
value.description: Asha decides she cannot answer the question from the kitchen and leaves the room, letting the unanswered issue stand.
evidence: the not-answering would have to stand.
She wiped the jam knife on the napkin, dropped it into the sink, and crouched for the bag at her feet
She lifted the strap to her shoulder
went out through the side door without looking back at Claire

value.name: Asha instructs the boy about the blue cup
value.description: Before leaving, Asha tells the boy that his brother likes the blue cup so he will know which one to carry upstairs.
evidence: told the boy his brother liked the blue cup so he would know which one to carry up

value.name: Asha carries the hidden bag to her car
value.description: Asha walks quickly down the side path and narrow drive to her car with the bag containing a folded form.
evidence: Outside, the air on the side path was cooler than the kitchen had been
Asha walked the length of the narrow drive to her car without slowing
the bag's strap shortening against her shoulder
the folded form a flat weight against the inside lining

value.name: Asha texts Rosa that she is moving
value.description: Asha sends Rosa a brief message saying the paper is in hand and she is moving now.
evidence: thumbed out a single line to Rosa: paper in hand, moving now

value.name: Asha drives off without waiting
value.description: Asha does not wait for Rosa's reply, starts the car, and pulls away from the curb without looking back at the house.
evidence: She did not wait for a reply
she set the phone in the cup holder face up and turned the key
Asha put the car into gear and pulled away from the curb without looking up at the house

value.name: Rosa deletes the message thread
value.description: Across the city, Rosa reads Asha's text immediately and erases the recent exchange history from her phone.
evidence: somewhere across the city Rosa, who had read it on the first vibration, opened the thread and cleared it, message by message, until the line of exchanges between them from the past three days was gone from the device in her hand

value.name: Asha begins the hospital trip
value.description: As Asha drives away, the planned hour-long trip to the hospital begins on her terms, with no immediate demand for explanation from the kitchen behind her.
evidence: the hour to the hospital began the way she had arranged for it to begin
with no one in the kitchen behind her required to say anything yet
